home.welcome: Welcome to our platform dedicated to content creators using AI! Whether you're an experienced filmmaker or a technology enthusiast, our festival is the perfect opportunity to showcase your innovative works. We look forward to discovering your creations and celebrating together the future of cinema in the age of artificial intelligence.
home.mission: Our mission is to provide an inclusive platform for content creators using AI, celebrating innovation, creativity, and diversity in cinema. We are committed to promoting works that push the boundaries of storytelling through artificial intelligence while fostering an open dialogue on the ethical and artistic implications of this revolutionary technology.

home.juryDesc: Discover the experts who evaluate our projects.

faq.q1: What are the prizes awarded at the festival?
faq.a1: Prizes include the Grand Jury Prize, Audience Award, and other special distinctions.
faq.q2: What should be the duration of the short film submitted?
faq.a2: The maximum allowed duration is 1 minute, including credits.
faq.q3: How can I submit my film?
faq.a3: You can submit your film via the submission form available on our website.
faq.a4: Yes, each participant can submit up to 3 different films.
faq.q5: Is the festival open to students?
faq.a5: Yes, the festival is open to everyone, including students.
faq.a6: Criteria include originality, artistic quality, and integration of AI.
faq.q7: How does the selection process work?
faq.a7: A jury of experts watches and selects the finalist films.
faq.q8: Do the films have to be unpublished?
faq.a8: Yes, films must not have been publicly screened before the festival.
faq.a9: Participation in the festival is free.
faq.q10: How can I attend the screenings?
faq.a10: Simply book your seat via the reservation page on the website.
